name: Xia Haoran
bio: Xia Haoran was born on May 21, 2001, in Beijing. He studied at Beijing Normal University and is a film and television actor as well as a basketball player in Mainland China. In 2018, he entered the entertainment industry by participating in the youth basketball show "This Is Slam Dunk Season 1". In 2020, he took part in the sports competition show "Youth On Fire". That same year, he starred in the drama film "No. 23". In 2022, the drama film "In the Name of Youth" starring Xia was released. In 2023, he starred in the urban romance drama "Nothing But You".

credits.title: Hidden Love
credits.overview: Sang Zhi quietly falls for Duan Jiaxu, her older brother’s college roommate. Years later, a chance reunion allows their once-hidden feelings to resurface, gradually turning an unspoken crush into a heartfelt romance.

credits.title: Number 23
credits.overview: A son, whose relationship with his mother is strained after his father’s disappearance, becomes acquainted with telephone dating service operator No. 23, bringing unexpected changes to him and his mother.

credits.title: Wonderful Youth
credits.overview: Xiao Yufan’s bold move earns him a spot on his high school basketball team, but he faces skepticism and challenges from teammates and classmates. As they train and grow together, their bond deepens. Balancing school and dreams, they strive for success in a crucial game, aiming for something remarkable.
